_readme: Manual verification of people whose name appears at more than one firm in the directory. Produced by web research (LinkedIn, firm bio pages, legal news) on 2026-08-04. Verdicts: SAME_PERSON_MOVED (confirmed real career move, cites a source), DIFFERENT_PEOPLE (confirmed two distinct individuals, cites separate profiles), UNVERIFIED (no public evidence either way - do not assume). Keyed by exact person name as it appears in structured_deals.json / legal_directory.json.

Prashant Sirohi.evidence: Bar & Bench: moved from SAM to Khaitan & Co's Projects and Project Finance practice in April 2026 alongside Mrinal Sharma and Samridha Neupane.

The real CAM Partner Saurabh Sharma (nearly a decade at CAM, confirmed via Bar & Bench/Lexology to have joined JSA as Partner, Ahmedabad, Corporate/GIFT City practice) would not be credited as a junior Associate on a different partner's due-diligence team. These are two distinct people sharing a name: a senior CAM-Partner-turned-JSA-Partner, and an unrelated, more junior CAM Associate.
